caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent, light blue glass vessel with two handles, set against a plain beige background. The vessel is wide and rounded in the body, with a slightly flared rim at the top. Each side features a curved handle, attached near the top of the body and looping outward before rejoining the vessel. The vessel sits on a short, thick stem that connects to a wide, circular base. Subtle shading and lines within the glass give the sense of three-dimensional form and transparency. The signature "Livingstone" is located in the bottom right corner of the image. There are no additional objects present in the composition.
title: Sugar Bowl
